connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — JERC 'NDS-I (Commercial), Demand Based' category, Table 6-3 'Tariff schedule approved by the Commission for FY 2025-26', JERC Tariff Order dated 24 Sept 2025 for Electricity Department, Govt. of Puducherry (Petition No. 139/2025, electricity.py.gov.in). Fixed charge is ₹200/kVA (not strictly kW) or part thereof/month, modelled here via the perLoad/perKW field. This approved schedule takes effect from 1 October 2025, slightly after this file's top-level effectiveFrom date; the file's residential slabs pre-date this order and were not revised as part of this update.

PRIMARY — JERC 'LTIS-I (Industries), Demand Based' category, Table 6-3 'Tariff schedule approved by the Commission for FY 2025-26', JERC Tariff Order dated 24 Sept 2025 for Electricity Department, Govt. of Puducherry (Petition No. 139/2025, electricity.py.gov.in). Fixed charge is ₹100/kVA (not strictly kW) or part thereof/month, modelled here via the perLoad/perKW field. Effective from 1 October 2025.

PRIMARY — JERC 'LTAS-I (Small Farmers), Connected Load Based' category, Table 6-3 'Tariff schedule approved by the Commission for FY 2025-26', JERC Tariff Order dated 24 Sept 2025 for Electricity Department, Govt. of Puducherry (Petition No. 139/2025, electricity.py.gov.in): heavily subsidised flat ₹0.25/kWh, fixed ₹10/kW or part thereof/month. Unmetered consumers under this category pay only the fixed charge (₹35/kW/month), not modelled here. 'LTAS-II (Other Farmers)' is a separate, less-subsidised demand-based category (₹0.35/kVAh, fixed ₹40/kVA) not modelled. Effective from 1 October 2025.
